name: Jorah site readers
description: Reads Adam's signed-in sites (EduPage first) through the reader-site agent, which jorah-guard limits to opening and reading each site's listed pages. Only checked fields come back: no links, people's names hidden, nothing typed or clicked.

sitesDir.description: config/sites: one file per signed-in site

sitesPrivateFile.description: Root-owned file with the sites' private parts; never in the repo

timeZone.description: Adam's time zone, for 'today' in the reader's brief
